prompt: Open the Term Report multi-page document (with header and footer) and produce a bullet summary of every section heading.

sections.heading: Section 1: Enrollment
sections.body: Term-two enrollment across the seven districts increased 3.2%.

sections.heading: Section 2: Attendance
sections.body: Attendance held steady at 94% average across primary schools.

sections.heading: Section 3: Assessments
sections.body: Continuous assessment scores show improvement in numeracy for grades 3-5.

sections.heading: Section 4: Staffing
sections.body: Two new teachers were assigned to Caroni; one long-term substitute in Victoria.
